purpose: Teach: 排斥/テロリズム/美化/道義/加担/横領/危害/儒教

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療現場での外国人排斥的言動は医療チームで厳禁としております
lines.en: Ren—we have a strict rule in our medical team that discriminatory behavior toward foreign patients is absolutely prohibited.
lines.style: Direct and steady, establishing a serious boundary. Measured delivery with emphasis on the hospital standard, not a personal rebuke. Clear-eyed, professional tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、テロリズム被害者の心のケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team takes on the mental health care of trauma survivors as part of our responsibility.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Slight pause before speaking—choosing words carefully. Warm undertone despite the gravity. Reassuring without being defensive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療結果の美化なく、貴院、報告されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital reports outcomes honestly, without embellishment, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine inquiry, not accusatory. Thoughtful tempo. A slight lift at the end—seeking confirmation of something he's observed or values.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、道義的判断を医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes, ethical judgment is something our medical team emphasizes in everything we do.
lines.style: Steady reaffirmation. Matter-of-fact but not cold. Slight weight on the word 'emphasizes'—showing this isn't lip service.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療事故に加担した職員への処分を、貴院、なさいましたね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital did take disciplinary action against staff who were involved in medical incidents, didn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle probe, not challenging. Respectful cadence. Seeking acknowledgment of something important. Softly curious—genuinely wanting to understand her approach.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療費横領の不正は医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Yes, we monitor for financial irregularities like embezzlement in our medical team—we take that very seriously.
lines.style: Firm on the substance, calm in delivery. Slight emphasis on 'monitor'—showing active oversight, not passive compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者に危害を与える医療行為を、貴院、絶対に避けますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital takes care to never cause harm to patients through medical practice, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Respectful phrasing but fundamentally asking about core values. Slow, deliberate. Looking for her confirmation of the principle.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、儒教文化を背景とした患者対応も医療チームで研修します
lines.en: Yes, our team also conducts training on patient care informed by Confucian values—it shapes how we approach relationships in medicine.
lines.style: Warm closing affirmation. Slightly more personal than previous responses—connecting ethics to cultural context. Gentle but assured.
